DQ9_category_variants.description: Spelling variants (English/Franco-Arabic/typos) recoverable via canonical map; ~5% larger after fix

DQ10_ghost_sensor.description: Ghost traffic counter present in data but absent from sensors reference; ~2.4% of traffic rows

DQ11_late_incidents.description: Incidents arriving 1-3 days after event time (created_at > event time)

DQ12_slow_drift.description: Continuous +1%/week drift from Mar 1 through Dec 31
